verdict.rationale: Fellow documents automatic AI extraction of action items with assignees ('suggested AI action items') from meetings, and these are collected/trackable via the app, API (get_action_items with owner/assignee filters like assigned_to_me/assigned_to_others), and Fellow Markdown format that stores 'action items with assignees and due dates'. Owners can also mark/archive action items and query them via MCP or webhooks, giving multiple ways to track them post-extraction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of extraction accuracy beyond vendor docs.
